android.desc: Button Master is Assistive Touch for Android: a floating button and edge gestures that replace a broken back button, home button or navigation bar. Lock the screen, take screenshots, record the screen and remap volume keys, one-handed, in one app. 🎛 Multiple Ways to Control Your Phone: ⭐️ Floating Buttons – Assistive Touch: ▫ Create multiple floating buttons like iOS Assistive Touch. ▫ Personalize each button with custom icons, battery, clock, or network info. ▫ Intuitive gesture controls: Supports tap, double-tap, long press, and 8-direction swipe. ▫ Smart Visibility: Auto-hide or auto-show buttons based on active apps. ⭐️ Edge Gestures – Gesture Navigation: ▫ Full-Screen Edge Triggers: Turn your screen edges into powerful command zones for Back button, Home button, and Recent Apps. ▫ Invisible & Space-Saving: The perfect navigation bar replacement. quotes.text:
Hmm I've never thought of having notes available on my lockscreen. Hardly even ever see it because face+fingerprint unlock combo.

I've been using Orgzly[0] as my note taker (and a lot more) and ButtonMaster[1] for rapid access. Unlock phone, swipe the floating BM button left, type my note (and maybe add properties, keywords and more) and hit save. Just now realizing too that it also supports creating notes via its notification. Never thought of using STT, but I have FUTO Keyboard[2] so that's also handled. And Syncthing[3] keeps it all synced with my laptop. All working together seamlessly for years.

[0] https://orgzlyrevived.com/
[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mozapps.buttonmaster.free
[2] https://keyboard.futo.org/
[3] https://f-droid.org/en/packages/com.github.catfriend1.syncthingandroid/
